method_target: Distinguish original UTC timestamp cadence eligibility (0.5-2.0 h), astronomical same local solar date/daypart continuity, and speed <=60 km/h from daily 3 DAY + 3 NIGHT steps and tag-year 10-day support. This is a source-admission *measurement* diagnostic, not new biological effect.
original_source_processing: Reuse frozen original one-fix-per-UTC-hour source file parser and one_taxon estimator, verify original provider MD5 and all source/native q and daylength support counts/means to source-frozen first results before publishing funnel metrics. Source-wide failure remains HOLD.
sample_unit: One distinct original source repository study-ID / DOI; native taxa and GPS fixes only clustered subobservations. Native source time/date/velocity funnel conditional on the source sample. Report each source/native counts, not individual dates/tags/coordinates/events.
rule_stage1: Original frozen source first-result recorded original UTC-hour-selected GPS positions. Consecutive original GPS fixes per tag produce adjacent intervals; original timestep must lie in [0.5,2.0] hours.
rule_stage2: Among original timestep-eligible adjacent fixes, solar_period(start) == solar_period(midpoint) == solar_period(end), SAME astronomy day/night and solar date as historical RSDS. This is location and timestamp information, NOT an actual direct sunlight observation.
rule_stage3: Among astronomy-eligible original steps, great_circle_km / elapsed_hours finite and <=60 km/h, matching source valid_interval exactly. This is an effect-relevant *geometry* constraint, NOT pure observation cadence.
rule_stage4: At least 3 valid DAY and 3 valid NIGHT GPS displacement steps within the same original tagged animal and solar date, then >=10 such original days within animal-year -> supported tag q, >=5 such tags for source-native q.
daylength_rule: For tag-year with >=10 eligible dates, astronomical daylength span >=0.5h produces locally identifiable within-year daylight slope; require >=5 tags within each native taxon as in archived one_taxon.
technical_cadence_summary: Preserve source/native counts of post-UTC-hour fixes, adjacent pairs, 0.5-2h time pairs, same astronomy daypart/time pairs, <=60km/h valid pairs, days with >=3 DAY/NIGHT accepted pairs, tag-years and animals meeting >=10 days; additionally even/odd UTC hour original source scheduling distribution. No original times, dates, animal IDs or GPS positions disclosed.
estimation: At most descriptive source-weighted median, range, and single-native vs multi-native q-measurability stratified results, with source-level exact deterministic permutation comparison only if predeclared; do not claim 25 parsed sources are globally representative.
privacy: One Homo sapiens original source must never be requested, downloaded or parsed; three original-file size HOLDS and three original GPS source-wide HOLDS retained (including if a subsequent retry behaves differently, no promotion from archival HOLD). Do not publish raw telemetry, tags, exact timestamps/dates, GPS positions, animal-level effects or per-segment trajectories.
cutoff_rule: No threshold tuning from outcome. Source original one_taxon and valid_interval acceptance are unchanged. This route only decomposes failure stages; does not modify old 35-source q effect endpoints.
